page.overview:
Who is Benz?

Commissar Benz (Russian: Комиссар Бенц) was a Soviet agent and a minor villain in the 1963 film From Russia with Love. He was played by Peter Bayliss in the film.

Benz is first seen during Bond's spying on a conference between himself, General Vassili, Koslovski and Krilencu in the Soviet Consulate as the latter is being chastised. He is briefly identified as head of the embassy's security staff by Ali Kerim Bey.

Some time later, he and another agent caught sight of James Bond and Tatiana Romanova, the latter a member of the embassy's staff; Benz correctly thought Romanova to be compromised, and pursued her and Bond aboard the Orient Express. He did not, however, have time to alert his superiors beforehand.

Ali Kerim Bey and his agent aboard the train later caught Benz and interrogated him in his passenger cabin. Not long after, however, both Benz and Bey were found dead, apparently having killed each other during an escape attempt by the former. In truth, Benz was stabbed by Red Grant during his and S.P.E.C.T.R.E.'s elaborate ruse to play the British and Soviets off each other.
